financial_base.basis: GAAP diluted EPS FY2025 derived = GAAP net income $506,921,000 (SEC 10-K fiscal year ended 2026-01-31, filed 2026-03-26) / 61,537,495 shares outstanding (financialcontent quote page, same date as price)
financial_base.normalization_note: Derived per-share basis, not a directly-tagged EPS figure in SEC XBRL (EarningsPerShareDiluted has no USD series for ANF in companyfacts). Numerator: GAAP net income FY2025 $506,921,000 per SEC 10-K filed 2026-03-26 (accession 0001018840-26-000012; concept NetIncomeLoss, end 2026-01-31). Denominator: 61,537,495 shares outstanding per financialcontent detailed quote (consistent with market cap $10.34B at $168.10). GAAP net income is used as-is (no material one-off identified); FY2025 net income ($506,9M) was below FY2024 ($566,2M), so this is a conservative base. Q3 FY2026 results were reported 24-nov-2026 (price +19,69% that day) but are not yet in SEC XBRL; the base may understate run-rate earnings if that strength persists. FCF FY2025 = operating cash flow $619,1M (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities) - capex $240,8M (PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment) = $378,4M, i.e. ~$6,15/share; balance sheet is net cash (~$759,5M cash, no material debt). Dividend: none.
